admission.justification: A dashboard-made failure overlay would hide the application recovery owner or falsely continue an already failed drawing wait.

applicability: Native failed-agent-load presentation on a dashboard/plugin pair negotiating that report.
conditions: The plugin first establishes exact selected-screen identity.
The native application displays its own failure pane and Retry.
exclusions: Older plugins without this report retain their separately disclosed behavior.

evidence: dashboard/src/cockpit/paseoFrameLateAnswer.test.tsx › "ends the wait when the application shows that the host could not load the agent: the line goes and its own Retry is in reach"; dashboard/src/cockpit/paseoPluginBridge.test.ts › "tells such a dashboard that the host could not load the agent when the application shows that pane, and then waits for nothing"; probe F-tip of Attempt3 (current plug-in): failure pane at 5.8 s, the dashboard's line gone at 5.9 s, the application's own Retry pressed; the architect's words are quoted in the report, part "Built beyond the nine, on the architect's word" (no ruling file)

statement: When the application shows its own pane for a host that could not load the agent, the current plug-in reports it and the dashboard removes its waiting line and lets input through; the dashboard names no failure of its own.
